results.task: Apply for a Facility Use Permit

checks.what: in the requester list as under_review

checks.actual: The purpose field must be at least 10 characters.

checks.what: a message for the start date
checks.actual: The requested start field must be a date before or equal to 2027-11-16.

results.task: Ask for a change, then resubmit

checks.what: requester can read the reviewer's note
resubmit accepted and back to under_review
rejecting without a reason is refused (422)
issued permit is valid with a date
unissued permit is not valid, with its status

results.task: Endorse the same application at once

checks.actual: Someone else acted on this permit first. It is now pending approval.

checks.what: the list shows the current status (pending_approval)
exactly one endorsement in the timeline

results.note: The web list reloading without Refresh after a 409 is covered by the Flutter test added in Week 17.

results.task: Open someone else's permit; approve own permit

checks.what: the refusal has a clear message
checks.actual: You are not allowed to do this.

results.task: Session ends, then sign in again

checks.what: after signing in again the permit is still there

results.note: The "your session ended" screen in the web app is the Week 14 U5 behaviour (screenshot U5).

checks.what: the cut connection fails without reaching the server
the next attempt creates the permit (201)
pressing Submit again returns the same permit (200, replayed)

results.note: The message that stays on the form is covered by the Week 16 Flutter test (U1).

results.task: Handle a notification that needs a person

checks.what: listed on the exceptions screen with a reason
after the fix it leaves the list

results.note: Fixing the address is an operator step (php artisan tinker); there is no admin edit screen (known limitation).
